# Meok Nis2 De Register MCP

> Germany NIS2 BSI register product — track Section 30/32 reporting timelines, KRITIS classificatio...

`meok-nis2-de-register-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install meok-nis2-de-register-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx meok-nis2-de-register-mcp
```

## Tools

See the package README for the full tool list: https://pypi.org/project/meok-nis2-de-register-mcp/
